archimate:Goal.name: Shared Care Planning: Collaborative Development and Maintenance of Coordinated Care Plans Across All Providers
archimate:Goal.documentation:
The "Shared Care Planning" goal is a collaborative healthcare objective focused on co-designing and maintaining a single, unified care plan with active participation from the patient, their caregivers, and their entire multidisciplinary care team.
Its purpose is to align all stakeholders on a consistent set of health goals, intervention strategies, and daily tasks, thereby reducing conflicting medical advice and placing the patient's personal preferences at the center of their treatment.
Example: A clinical team achieves this goal by using an interactive portal where a patient with heart failure, their cardiologist, and a home-health nurse can jointly set weekly sodium limits, schedule physical therapy, and track daily weight measurements in real time.
